plugins.name: papermark
plugins.description: Papermark is the virtual data room and secure document-sharing platform for your agents. Build and organize data rooms for deals and due diligence, share documents behind secure links (password, email-gating, expiry, watermarks, screenshot protection), and read view analytics down to per-page read time. Makes Grok Build fluent in Papermark: data rooms, documents, links, viewers, and analytics. Bundles the official Papermark MCP server and works with the published `papermark` CLI.
